sentences.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND, RANCHI  ----
W.P.(Cr.) No. 885 of 2023 ----
 Sonu Kumar .... Petitioner  -- Versus --  The State of Jharkhand and Another .... Respondents  ----
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR DWIVEDI ---
For the Petitioner :- Mr. Mohan Kumar Dubey, Advocate For the State :- Mrs. Shourya Dwivedi,
Advocate ----
2/18.10.2023

The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the case has been registered under section 498A and other sections of the I.P.C and section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
He submits that the entire family has been implicated in the case wherein only general and omnibus allegations are made.

He further submits that this petitioner is husband of the respondent no.2 and by way of referring paragraph no.6 of the petition, he submits that the petitioner is ready to keep her with all dignity and the informant is not willing to live with the petitioner and his family and thus, she has left her matrimonial house.
2. Issue notice upon the respondent no.2 by registered post with A/d as well as under ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week after Durga Puja Vacation.
3. Let it appear on 12.12.2023.
4. Till the next date, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Patratu Bhurkunda P.S.Case No.157 of 2023, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ramgarh.
